svg.title: AirDial: calibration
svg.desc: At start-up every display dims. The active display gets a yellow frame and shows a red dot with a filling green progress ring; the person points at it and holds still until it chimes. An inset shows the dot order: the centre and the four corners of each display, from left to right.
svg.text: Calibration — point at each dot and hold still until it chimes
